defects: Codomain uses plain `ι → F` with a single arbitrary `[TopologicalSpace F]` instance shared across all coordinates, instead of `(i : ι) → WithAbs (v i)` where each coordinate carries the distinct topology induced by its own absolute value v i — this changes the meaning of DenseRange entirely, since in the produced version every factor has the same topology (unrelated to any v i), whereas the gold statement crucially relies on each factor having a different, v_i-induced topology

Adds an unconstrained hypothesis `[TopologicalSpace F]` that has no connection to the absolute values v, which is not present in the gold statement and makes the produced statement a different (and generally not equivalent, likely trivial/false as intended) proposition
The diagonal map is expressed as a bare lambda `fun x i => x` into `ι → F` rather than as `algebraMap F ((i : ι) → WithAbs (v i))`, consistent with the wrong topology structure above
